svg.title: CCC vs DCC
svg.desc: CCC fixes correlation and moves only variances; DCC updates correlation from standardized residuals and captures the crisis spike.
svg.text: CCC vs DCC — is correlation a constant or a state?
A multivariate model where only variances move vs one where correlation moves too
only two extra parameters, a and b
Step 2: estimate a and b by likelihood
Correlation stays put even in a crisis
Only the variances grow; correlation stays fixed
As calm returns, correlation drifts back down
The correlation matrix is identical in all three regimes
The correlation matrix differs by regime
Off-diagonals darken in the crisis — diversification disappears
CCC moves only variances and fixes correlation; DCC updates correlation as well.
The observation that correlations rise in a crisis cannot be captured by CCC.
Next: in-sample fit vs out-of-sample forecasting.
